<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Birthday Party|id=A0002}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
How to ask someone to go together to a birthday party—in Lojban? With Liliana's and JP's guidance it's pretty easy. Of course, that doesn't mean that the answer is always “yes”! In any case, the keyword is '''la fiesta de cumpleaños''' – the birthday party. 
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0010|A0010: I'm hungry]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0021|A0021: I'm sleepy]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0127|A0127: Flirting]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Hola! ¿Vas a la fiesta?'''
| Hello! Are you going to the party?
| '''¿Cuál fiesta?'''
| What party?
| '''La fiesta de cumpleaños de Javier.'''
| Javier's birthday party/the birthday party of Javier.
| '''Sí voy a ir. ¿Vamos juntos?'''
| Sure/yes I'm going to go. Shall we go together?
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¡Hola! ¿Vas a la fiesta?'''
| Hello! Are you going to the party?
| '''¿Cuál fiesta?'''
| What party?
| '''La fiesta de cumpleaños de Javier.'''
| Javier's birthday party/the birthday party of Javier.
| '''Sí voy a ir. ¿Vamos juntos?'''
| Sure/yes I'm going to go. Shall we go together?
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Hello! Do you go to the party? | '''¡Hola! ¿Vas a la fiesta?'''
| Which party? | '''¿Cuál fiesta?'''
| The birthday party of Javier. | '''La fiesta de cumpleaños de Javier.'''
| Sure I'm going to go. Do we go together? | '''Sí voy a ir. ¿Vamos juntos?'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Hello! Do you go to the party? | '''¡Hola! ¿Vas a la fiesta?'''
| Which party? | '''¿Cuál fiesta?'''
| The birthday party of Javier. | '''La fiesta de cumpleaños de Javier.'''
| Sure I'm going to go. Do we go together? | '''Sí voy a ir. ¿Vamos juntos?'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Are you going to go to the party? | '''¿Vas a ir a la fiesta?'''
| Yes, I'm going to go to the party of Javier. | '''Sí, voy a ir a la fiesta de Javier.'''
| Are we going to go together to the party? | '''¿Vamos a ir juntos a la fiesta?'''
| What party? | '''¿Cuál fiesta?'''
| Hello? Javier's party. | '''¿Hola? La fiesta de Javier.'''
| Yes, the birthday party of Javier. | '''Sí, la fiesta de cumpleaños de Javier.'''
| Yes. Do we go together to the party? | '''Sí. ¿Vamos juntos a la fiesta?'''
| Sure I am going to go to the party. | '''Sí voy a ir a la fiesta.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Are you going to go to the party? | '''¿Vas a ir a la fiesta?'''
| Yes, I'm going to go to the party of Javier. | '''Sí, voy a ir a la fiesta de Javier.'''
| Are we going to go together to the party? | '''¿Vamos a ir juntos a la fiesta?'''
| What party? | '''¿Cuál fiesta?'''
| Hello? Javier's party. | '''¿Hola? La fiesta de Javier.'''
| Yes, the birthday party of Javier. | '''Sí, la fiesta de cumpleaños de Javier.'''
| Yes. Do we go together to the party? | '''Sí. ¿Vamos juntos a la fiesta?'''
| Sure I am going to go to the party. | '''Sí voy a ir a la fiesta.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the [[#More Vocabulary|More Vocabulary]] section.
{{SbcQuestion
| Hello! Do you go to the party? (formal) | '''¡Hola! ¿(Usted) va a la fiesta?'''
| Which party? | '''¿Cuál fiesta?'''
| The birthday party of Javier. | '''La fiesta de cumpleaños de Javier.'''
| Sure I'm going to go. Do you go together? (formal, plural) | '''Sí voy a ir. ¿(Ustedes) van juntos?'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the More Vocabulary section.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Hello! Do you go to the party? (formal) | '''¡Hola! ¿(Usted) va a la fiesta?'''
| Which party? | '''¿Cuál fiesta?'''
| The birthday party of Javier. | '''La fiesta de cumpleaños de Javier.'''

}}</includeonly>
